主席報告
CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT



本人欣然向各位股東提呈本公司及本集團二零                        I am pleased to present to shareholders a review of the performance
二三年十二月三十一日止年度之業績回顧與二零                       of the Company and the Group for the year ended 31 December
二四年展望。                                      2023 and our outlook for 2024.

「十四五」以來，房地產行業呈現出了規模收縮、                      Since the beginning of the “14th Five-Year Plan”, the real estate
 城市分化、市場集中度提升等趨勢性、結構性的                      sector has undergone significant trends and structural shifts, such as
 變 化，銷 售 市 場 從 二 零 二 一 年 人 民 幣 18 萬 億 元     scale contraction, escalating divergence among cities, and increased

     人民幣匯率波動不會對本集團財務狀況帶                       range of the RMB exchange rate has further expanded.
     來 顯 著 影 響。同 時，本 集 團 對 外 匯 風 險 敞          However, the Group’s overall foreign exchange risk is
     口實施動態監控並將根據市場環境的變化                       manageable, and RMB exchange rate fluctuations will not have
     進行必要調整。                                  a significant impact on the Group’s financial condition.
                                              Additionally, the Group implements dynamic monitoring of
                                              foreign exchange risk exposure and will make necessary
                                              adjustments based on changes in the market environment.

7.   或有負債                                7.   Contingent Liabilities

     本集團就部分物業的買家所獲按揭貸款向                       The Group provides interim guarantees to banks for mortgage
     銀 行 做 出 階 段 性 擔 保。銀 行 將 於 買 家 獲 發        loans obtained by buyers of certain of our properties. The banks
     出房屋所有權證或有關物業買家完成按揭                       will release these guarantees upon the issuance of property
     貸款之後（以較早者為準）解除該等擔保。                      ownership certificates or upon the completion of mortgage
     董 事 會 認 為，該 等 財 務 擔 保 合 約 之 公 平 值        loans by such property buyers, whichever occurs earlier. The
     並不重大。                                    Board believes that the fair value of these financial guarantee
                                              contracts is not significant.

本公司執行董事及本公司高級管理人員整體薪酬                        The total remuneration of executive Directors and senior management
由基本工資、績效獎金及中長期激勵計劃三個主                        of the Company comprises three key components, namely basic

績與戰略目標，並基於整體業績目標向各執行董                        Company sets its strategic and performance targets on an annual and
事及高級管理人員分派任務，並按照設定的衡量                        long-term basis. Based on the Company’s overall performance targets,
標準與方法進行考核。績效獎金根據年度績效考                        the Company assigns responsibilities and sets performance
核結果確定，促進年度業績目標達成，中長期激                        benchmarks and evaluation methods for each executive Director and
勵與公司中長期戰略目標關聯，根據戰略週期考                        members of the senior management team. To promote the
核結果確定，實現企業經營管理者與企業所有者                        achievement of annual performance goals, actual performance is
利益的統一，促進公司健康發展。                              assessed against annual performance targets in order to determine
                                             the bonus. To align the interests of owners and management team of
                                             the Company and promote healthy development of the Company,
                                             the mid-to-long term incentive scheme is correlated with mid-to-long
                                             term strategic targets of the Company and determined by evaluating
                                             the performance in corresponding strategical period.

的組織架構、政策和程序的制訂、授權的界定基                     implementation and monitoring of the risk management and internal

附註：                                     Notes:

(a)   其他儲備主要包括資本儲備、一般儲備、特別儲備、           (a)      Other reserves mainly comprise capital reserve, general reserve, special
      合併儲備、物業、廠房及設備轉撥至投資物業時之                     reserve, merger reserve, revaluation gain of property, plant and equipment
      重估收益及指定為透過其他全面收益按公平值列賬                     when transferred to investment properties and changes in fair value of equity
      之股本工具公平值變動。                                instruments designated at FVOCI.

      根據中華人民共和國（「中國」）相關法例及法規所規                   As stipulated by the relevant laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of
      定，本集團之中國內地附屬公司須提撥除稅後溢利                     China (the “PRC”), the Group’s subsidiaries in the Chinese Mainland shall set
      10% 作為一般儲備，直至一般儲備達相關附屬公司                   aside 10% of their profit after taxation for the general reserve until the

4.   重大會計政策                                 4.   MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES
     附屬公司及非控股權益                                  SUBSIDIARIES AND NON-CONTROLLING
                                                 INTERESTS

     附 屬 公 司 指 受 本 集 團 控 制 的 實 體。當 本 集           Subsidiaries are entities controlled by the Group. The Group
     團承受或享有自參與實體營運而取得的可                          controls an entity when it is exposed to, or has rights to, variable
     變 回 報，並 能 藉 着 對 實 體 施 加 權 力 而 影 響           returns from its involvement with the entity and has the ability
     該 等 回 報 時，則 本 集 團 控 制 該 實 體。附 屬             to affect those returns through its power over the entity. The
     公司的財務報表自控制權開始之日起至控                          financial statements of subsidiaries are included in the
     制權終止之日均包含於綜合財務報表中。                          consolidated financial statements from the date on which
                                                 control commences until the date on which control ceases.

     集團內部結餘及交易與集團內部交易產生                          Intra-group balances and transactions, and any unrealised
     的任何未變現收入及開支（外幣交易收益或                         income and expenses (except for foreign currency transaction
     虧損除外）抵銷。集團內部交易所引致的未                         gains or losses) arising from intra-group transactions, are
     變現虧損的抵銷方法與未變現收益相同，                          eliminated. Unrealised losses resulting from intra-group
     惟抵銷額只限於沒有證據顯示已出現減值                          transactions are eliminated in the same way as unrealised gains,
     的部分。                                        but only to the extent that there is no evidence of impairment.

     就 各 項 業 務 合 併 而 言，本 集 團 可 選 擇 按 公           For each business combination, the group can elect to measure
     平值或非控股權益應佔附屬公司可識別資                          any non-controlling interests (“NCI”) either at fair value or at
     產淨值之比例計量任何非控股權益（「非控                         the NCI’s proportionate share of the subsidiary’s net identifiable
     股 權 益」）。非 控 股 權 益 於 綜 合 財 務 狀 況 表           assets. NCI are presented in the consolidated statement of
     之權益內與本公司權益股東應佔權益分開                          financial position within equity, separately from equity
     呈 列。本 集 團 業 績 內 之 非 控 股 權 益 於 綜 合           attributable to the equity shareholders of the company. NCI in
     損益表及綜合損益及其他全面收益表內，                          the results of the Group are presented on the face of the
     呈列為年內損益總額以及全面收益總額在                          consolidated statement of profit or loss and the consolidated
     非控股權益與本公司權益股東之間的分配。                         statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income as
     來自非控股權益持有人的貸款及該等持有                          an allocation of the total profit or loss and total comprehensive
     人的其他合同責任於綜合財務狀況表呈列                          income for the year between NCI and the equity shareholders of
     為金融負債，惟須視乎負債的性質而定。                          the company. Loans from holders of NCI and other contractual
                                                 obligations towards these holders are presented as financial
                                                 liabilities in the consolidated statement of financial position
                                                 depending on the nature of the liability.

     本集團於附屬公司的權益變動如不會導致                          Changes in the Group’s interests in a subsidiary that do not

     公平值計量                                    FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENT

     公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者之間於                       Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or
     有序交易中出售資產所收取或轉讓負債所                       paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between
     支 付 的 價 格，不 管 該 價 格 是 否 可 直 接 觀 察        market participants at the measurement date, regardless of
     得 到 或 使 用 另 一 估 值 技 巧 而 估 計。於 估 計        whether that price is directly observable or estimated using
     資 產 或 負 債 的 公 平 值 時，倘 市 場 參 與 者 於        another valuation technique. In estimating the fair value of an
     計量當日為資產或負債定價時將會考慮的                       asset or a liability, the Group takes into account the
     資 產 或 負 債 的 特 點 時，則 本 集 團 會 考 慮 該        characteristics of the asset or liability if market participants
     等特點。                                     would take those characteristics into account when pricing the
                                              asset or liability at the measurement date.

     非金融資產公平值之計量則參考市場參與                       A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
     者可從使用該資產得到之最高及最佳效用，                      account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
     或把該資產售予另一可從使用該資產得到                       benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
     最高及最佳效用之市場參與者所產生之經                       selling it to another market participant that would use the asset
     濟效益。                                     in its highest and best use.

     此 外，就 財 務 報 告 而 言，公 平 值 計 量 乃 根          In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
     據公平值計量輸入數據的可觀察程度及公                       measurements are categorised into Level 1, 2 or 3 based on the
     平值計量輸入數據的整體重要性而劃分為                       degree to which the inputs to the fair value measurements are

         以外就資產或負債可直接或間接觀察                           included within Level 1, that are observable for the asset

     評 估 時，本 集 團 比 較 於 報 告 日 期 金 融 工 具           initial recognition. When making the assessment, the Group

15. 投資物業（續）                                   15. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (continued)
  附註：                                            Notes:

  (a)   本集團的估值程序                                 (a)      Valuation processes of the Group

        本集團按公平值對其投資物業進行計量。本                               The Group measures its investment properties at fair value. The fair
        集團投資物業於二零二三年十二月三十一日                               value of the Group’s investment properties as at 31 December 2023
        的公平值是根據仲量聯行企業評估及諮詢有                               has been determined on the basis of valuation carried out by Jones
        限 公 司 及 萊 坊 有 限 責 任 合 夥（均 為 獨 立 及 專               Lang LaSalle Corporate Appraisal and Advisory Limited and Knight
        業合資格估值師）進行的估值而釐定。                                 Frank LLP, all are independent and professionally qualified valuers.

        管理層與估值師每六個月最少對估值過程及                               Discussions of valuation processes and results are held between
        結果進行一次討論，與本集團之中期及年度                               management and valuers at least once every six months, in line with
        報告時間一致。                                           the timing of Group’s interim and annual reporting.

  (b)   估值技術                                     (b)      Valuation techniques

        估值採用之估值方法包括已落成物業所用的                               The valuation methodologies adopted in valuations include income
        收 益 法 及╱或 直 接 比 較 法，在 建 物 業 所 用 的                 approach and/or direct comparison method for completed properties
        剩 餘 法、直 接 比 較 法 及╱或 成 本 法，以 及 使                   and residual method, direct comparison method and/or cost method
        用權資產所用之收益法及╱或剩餘法。                                 for the properties under construction and income approach and/or
                                                          residual method for the right-of-use assets.

        收益法通過計算標的物業當前租約的租金收                               The income approach operates by taking into account the rental
        入，並計算出租及空置部份的潛在租金收入，                              income of the subject property derived from the existing tenancies
        然後按合適的資本化率將其資本化為價值。                               with due allowance for the potential reversionary income of the
                                                          tenanted and vacant portions, which are then capitalised at an
                                                          appropriate capitalisation rate.

        直接比較法涉及分析近期巿場上同類型物業                               The direct comparison method involves the analysis of recent market
        的案例並與該等估值物業進行比較。選取面                               evidence of similar properties and comparing them with the subject
        積大小、屬性及位置類近的可資比較物業進                               property under valuation. Comparable properties with similar size,
        行 分 析，並 仔 細 權 衡 各 自 的 優 劣 之 處，從 而                 characteristics and locations are analysed, and carefully weighed
        達至公允的評估價值。                                        against all respective advantage and disadvantages in order to arrive
                                                          at a fair comparison of value.

        剩餘法考慮總發展價值並扣除尚未發生的建                               The residual method takes into account the residual value of the gross
        築成本、開支以及發展利潤後的剩餘價值。                               development value (“GDV”) after deduction of the outstanding
        剩餘法首先計算假設建議發展項目於估值日                               construction costs and expenses as well as profit element. It involves
        已落成的合計總發展價值。建議發展項目的                               firstly the assessment of the aggregate GDV of the proposed
        估 計 成 本 包 括 建 築 成 本、市 場 推 廣 支 出、專                 development, as if completed, as at the valuation date. Estimated
        業 費 用、財 務 費 用 以 及 相 關 成 本，另 加 發 展                 costs of the proposed development include construction costs,
        商的風險及利潤撥備。尚未發生的開發成本                               marketing expense, professional fee, finance charges and associated
        將由總發展價值中扣除，並得出標的物業的                               costs, plus an allowance for the developer’s risk and profit. The
        剩餘價值。                                             outstanding development costs are then deducted from the GDV and
                                                          the resultant figure is the residual value of the subject property.

        成本法採用總重置成本以得出標的物業於估                               The cost approach is a method of using gross replacement costs to
        值日現狀的價值。成本法需要估算該土地現                               arrive at the value of the subject property in its existing state as at the
        值，另加該土地上改造工程的重置成本估算。                              valuation date. The cost approach requires estimates of the current
        改造工程重置成本包括建築工程成本、地盤                               value of the land plus the estimated replacement cost of the land
        工程成本、財務費用及工程相關成本。                                 improvement works. The replacement cost of the improvement works
                                                          includes the cost of the building work, site works, finance charges
                                                          and relevant associated costs.

        於估計物業公平值時，物業的最高及最佳用                               In estimating the fair value of the properties, the highest and best use
        途為其現時用途。                                          of the properties is their current use.

       沖工具及被對沖項目之公平值變動                                fair value movements of the hedging instrument and the
                                                      hedged item

  計 劃。根 據 強 積 金 計 劃 規 則，僱 主 及 僱 員        the principle of the Mandatory Provident Fund Scheme
  須按僱員薪金 5% 供款，每月供款上限為每                  Ordinance. Under the rules of MPF Scheme, the employer and
  名僱員港幣 1,500 元。強積金計劃資產由獨                its employees are required to contribute 5% of the employee’s
  立管理基金持有，與集團公司資產分開持有。                   salaries, up to a maximum of HK$1,500 per employee per
                                         month. The assets of the MPF Scheme are held separately from
